pretreatments.description: Mechanical pretreatment consisting of grinding the biomass into ≤20 mm mesh sizes using a hammer mill.
Thermal treatment at 80 °C for 60 minutes using a water bath.
Chemical pretreatment using alkaline solution (3 g NaOH per 100 g TS) at 55 °C for 24 hours with a solid loading of 35 g TS/L.
